title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
hook_text: xAI faces a major environmental lawsuit
script:
A federal judge just greenlit the NAACP lawsuit against xAI. The case concerns the company's Memphis data center.
The NAACP claims the facility operates twenty-seven gas turbines without proper permits. They argue this violates the Clean Air Act.
The lawsuit alleges xAI installed these turbines to power its compute cluster. These turbines emit nitrogen oxides into the local air.
Elon Musk's company previously faced criticism for rushing the facility's construction last year. The site processes heavy data loads for AI models.
The judge rejected xAI's request to dismiss the civil rights and environmental claims. This ruling allows the legal battle to proceed.
Would you want a massive data center built in your neighborhood?
